demo.writes: Demo mode: your answer is kept only in this server's memory and is forgotten when it restarts.
demo.employer: Demo mode: you're reviewing as an example Nashik employer.

employer.title: Tell us who you need
employer.lede: Tell us who you need. It takes about 6 minutes, and it changes what ITIs near you teach.
employer.why: Answer for one role you hire for. Only district totals are ever shown, never your organisation's name.
employer.inboxBody: ITIs near you have proposed changes to their courses. Tell them if the changes match what you hire for.

survey.storageNote: Your answers are saved on this device as you go, so you can come back later.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.desc: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

role.title: The role you're hiring for
role.desc: Pick one role. If you hire for several, fill the survey again later.

skills.title: The skills you need
skills.desc: Start with the most important. Up to 5 skills.

hires.title: Your recent hires
hires.desc: People you hired from an ITI or PMKVY centre in the last 12 months.

consent.collect: What we collect: your organisation's name, district, sector and hiring needs.
consent.why: Why: to estimate skill demand by district and to suggest changes to skill-course curricula. Nothing else.
consent.show: What we show: only totals by district, sector and role. Never your organisation's name.
consent.never: What we never do: sell your data, share your details, or use them for marketing.
consent.keep: How long we keep it: until the end of the hackathon evaluation, or longer only if the Government of Maharashtra adopts the project and you are told.
consent.rights: Your rights: you can ask to see, correct or delete your answers at any time, and withdraw consent the same way.
consent.question: Do you agree to share this information for the purpose above?
consent.yes: Yes, I agree to share this information for the purpose above
consent.noNote: That's fine. Nothing has been recorded. You can close this page.

fields.udyamHint: Looks like UDYAM-MH-00-0000000. It helps us count one employer once.
fields.lgd: Which district is your workplace in?
fields.sector: What does your organisation mainly do?
fields.sectorOther: Tell us in your own words
fields.role: Which role are you answering about?
fields.roleHint: Pick the closest one. If it's not here, choose Other and type it in your own words.
fields.roleOther: The role, in your own words
fields.hires: How many people do you expect to hire for this role in the next 12 months?
fields.hiresHint: A rough number is fine. Count new hires only, not people already working.
fields.ratio: When you advertise this kind of role online, how many people do you finally hire per advertisement?
fields.ratioHint: Think about the last 12 months. This tells us how to read online job ads for your area.
fields.skillSearchHint: Type a few letters, for example "solar", "CNC", "Tally" or "wiring".
fields.skillNoMatch: No matching skill yet. Try a shorter word, or describe it in the comment at the end.
fields.skillsFull: That's 5 skills, the most we ask for.
fields.importance: How important is this skill when you hire?
fields.proficiency: What level do they need on day one?
fields.csat: How satisfied are you with the people you hired from ITIs or PMKVY centres in the last 12 months?
fields.csatLow: 1 = Not at all ready for the job
fields.weeks: How long does a new ITI or PMKVY hire take to work at full speed?
fields.comment: Anything ITIs should teach, stop teaching, or teach differently?

sectors.27: Manufacturing: electrical equipment, including solar and EV

ratios.none: We posted, but hired nobody from it
ratios.lt1: Less than 1 hire per ad (many ads, few hires)
ratios.offline: We don't advertise this role online

importance.mandatory: Must-have: we won't hire without it
importance.preferred: Preferred: we hire faster if they have it
importance.nice: Nice to have: we can teach it on the job

proficiency.1: 1. Basic: knows what it is, can do it with close supervision
proficiency.2: 2. Working: can do routine tasks alone
proficiency.3: 3. Advanced: handles problems and non-routine jobs alone
proficiency.4: 4. Expert: can set it up, fix anything, and train others

errors.summaryTitle: Please fix these before going on
errors.number: Please type a whole number, like 12.
errors.range: Please use a number from 0 to 5,000.
errors.tooLong: That's a little long. Please shorten it.
errors.pattern: This doesn't look like a Udyam number (UDYAM-MH-00-0000000). You can leave it blank.
errors.consent: We can only record answers if you agree. If you don't, nothing is saved.
errors.skills: Please add at least one skill.
errors.unknown: One of the skills isn't in our list. Please remove it and pick again.
errors.server: We couldn't send your answers just now. They're still saved on this device; please try again.
errors.slow: Lots of answers from this device in the last minute. Please wait a minute and send again; your answers are kept.

thanks.title: Your answer counts
thanks.counted: Your {hires} expected hires for {role} now count in {district}'s skill demand.
thanks.others: Other employers told us something similar:
thanks.skills: The skills you named ({skills}) go into the list ITIs in {district} are checked against, with your {mustHave} must-haves marked as must-haves.
thanks.courses: In {district} that's {courses} courses at {institutes} institutes. When one of them is missing what you asked for, we suggest a change and send it to local employers like you to review.
thanks.coursesNone: We don't track a course in {district} for this yet. Your answer is how we show that one is needed.
thanks.rights: To see, correct or delete your answers, write to the team. You can withdraw consent at any time.

prs.title: Course changes to review
prs.lede: ITIs and training centres near you have proposed changes. You know what you hire for: tell them if they've got it right.
prs.empty: Nothing to review right now. We'll send you the next change when an ITI near you proposes one.

review.legend: Does this change match what you hire for?
review.commentHint: For example: "Add Fanuc controls, not Siemens."
review.thanks: Thank you. The ITI will see your answer.
review.error: We couldn't send that just now. Please try again.
review.pick: Choose one of the three answers.

me.title: Where can your skills take you?
me.lede: Tell us what you can do, in your own words. We'll show you jobs near you that need it, and what to learn next.
me.privacy: No login. We don't keep what you type: it is read once (by Google's Gemini AI when it's available) and then forgotten. Your results live only in this page's link.
me.textHint: Write it the way you'd say it. Marathi, English or both is fine.
me.placeholder: For example: I can do house wiring and fix inverters. मला wiring आणि solar panel बसवता येतं.
me.submit: Show me where I can go
me.errText: Please write a few words about what you can do.
me.resultTitle: Here's where your skills can take you in {district}
me.understood: What we understood you can do
me.viaAi: Our AI helper read what you wrote.
me.viaWords: Our AI helper was busy, so we matched your words against our skill list ourselves. It may miss a skill or two.
me.viaNone: We couldn't pick out a skill from what you wrote, so these are the jobs most in demand near you. Try again with the names of tools or tasks you know.
me.nearby: In nearby districts ({names}), about {n} more could be hired.
me.haveAll: You already have the skills employers ask for here.
me.noCourse: We don't know of a course with seats for this yet. Ask at your nearest ITI.
me.freeNote: A starting point, not a recommendation: check the course before you enrol.
me.noPaths: We don't have enough job data for {district} yet to suggest a path. Try a nearby district.
